hints.title: String Copying and In-Place Obstacle
hints.text: Creating a filtered copy of the alphanumeric characters and reversing it allocates extra space. How can you compare corresponding characters from opposite sides in place while skipping punctuation?

hints.title: Two Pointers Converging Inward
hints.text: Start indices at the first and last characters of the string. Advance past non-alphanumeric characters and compare lowercase values inward until the boundaries meet or cross.

hints.title: In-Place While Loop Traversal
hints.text: Place a left index at 0 and a right index at length - 1. While left < right, skip any characters that are not alphanumeric. When both point to valid characters, compare their lowercase forms; if they differ, return false. If they match, advance both inward.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (1 <= N <= 2 * 10^5)
complexity.notes: Single inward pass comparing characters directly without copying or filtering into a new string.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Filtering the string into a new cleaned string and reversing it requires O(N) auxiliary space, which allocates extra memory and creates unnecessary string copies on large strings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Traversing inward in place uses O(1) auxiliary space and terminates early on the first mismatch, whereas string reversal always performs full copies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: In-place traversal with O(1) extra space, bounds checking while skipping non-alphanumeric characters, case-insensitive comparison, and handling empty/single-character strings.
